name: Projected Maximal Degree of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: Projecting to three consecutive cyclic coordinates yields the seven traces $001,010,011,100,101,110,111$; four of these have degree three in the projected $1$-inclusion graph.  Checking all $31$ coordinate projections of the ten $C_5$ strings gives no vertex of degree larger than three.  Thus the projected maximal degree is three.
